planets.name: Kepler-63 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-63 with a 9.43-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-63 b was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-63. Its orbit and size follow Sanchis-Ojeda et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
